q1.sampleAnswer:
Hi Lennie,
Yes! I’m so excited too. It’s so good for me and my family. I love water sports. My family is excited too. My mum miss you. My father loves sailing.
You asked me “would you like to try water skiing?” actually my answer is no, because I don’t like skiing. I think we should try another water sport. Would you like to give some different advice? I have no idea.
Then you asked “what clothes should I bring to change into?” Suggest you should wear adress or t-shirt and pants, normal clothes is fine!
I think we are getting back 8 o’clock. I miss you so much. See you tomorrow.
Byee!

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：回应邮件中的四条笔记：①回答自己也很期待（Yes!）；②拒绝尝试滑水，并说明原因（No, because …）；③建议 Lennie 带什么衣服，饭前换上（Suggest …）；④告诉 Lennie 晚上几点回来（Tell Lennie）
交际效果：文体和语气符合任务要求，能清楚表达观点并吸引读者
条理性：结构清晰、衔接连贯，使用多种连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的丰富性与准确性

anchors.noteZh: 内容5/交际效果4/条理性3/语言3。四个要点都已回应；语气友好、非正式（I’m so excited too, I have no idea），开头和结尾适合写给朋友（Hi Lennie, I miss you so much, See you tomorrow, Byee）；每段回应一个要点，用 You asked me, actually, because, Then you asked 等基础衔接；能恰当使用日常词汇和疑问句等简单结构，但很多词照搬题目（excited, sailing, water skiing, getting back），有少量错误，不影响理解。

anchors.response:
Hi Lennie
First I need to tell I’m so excited too for tomorrow. Finally we can talk face to face with each other while sailing! And you asked me about water skiing, I’m afraid I have to say no because I’m afraid of extreme sports. But I can watch you while you do try water skiing if you want. Your other question was about clothes. I would suggest you a nice dress but if you want to wear casual clothes there won’t be a problem. And about going back to home we can drive you home about 9 p.m. Is it OK for your mum. Let me know.
Amir
anchors.noteZh: 内容5/交际效果5/条理性4/语言4。四个要点都充分回应；语气友好自然（Finally we can talk face to face, I’m afraid I have to say no, Is it OK for your mum），能吸引读者；虽然只有一段，但用 First, Finally, And, because, But, while, Your other question 等把观点连接起来；词汇恰当（face to face, extreme sports, casual clothes, drive you home），用了条件句等较复杂结构（if you want to wear … there won’t be a problem），有 I would suggest you a nice dress 等小错误，不影响理解。

q1.explanationZh: 满分邮件要回应四条笔记：表示自己也很兴奋、拒绝滑水并说明原因、建议带什么衣服、告诉 Lennie 回来的时间；语气友好，衔接自然，约 100 词。

q2.sampleAnswer:
Hello there!
Im Ken, I like a lot taking photos my mom said a week ago that if I wanted to be a photografer I could, Im an expert so.
Many people take a lot of photos to remember in the future good moments like a trip or things like that.
I don’t mind of taking photos of specific things I just let my imagination free, and for example a regular sunday I was bored so I went to my garden and saw my cat there and I took him a photo just because I was bored but it also could be like the plants or a butterfly, anything, that photo of my car is my favorite one.

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：文章回答三个问题：①人们为什么拍那么多照片；②自己喜欢拍什么；③有没有一张经常看的最喜欢的照片
交际效果：文体和语气符合任务要求，能清楚表达观点并吸引读者
条理性：结构清晰、衔接连贯，使用多种连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的丰富性与准确性

anchors.noteZh: 内容5/交际效果3/条理性3/语言3。三个问题都有回应，但第三个问题答得太简短；用文章体裁，语气友好（Hello there），表达了个人看法（I like a lot, I don’t mind）；有引入段，按顺序回答各个问题，用 and, for example, so, because, but 等基础连接词，但该用句号的地方用了逗号，很难判断句子在哪里结束，影响理解；能用一些日常词汇（specific things, let my imagination free）和结构（if I wanted to be a photographer I could），有 I don’t mind of, I took him a photo, that photo of my car 等错误，但不妨碍理解。

anchors.response:
I think a photograph can be a piece of art, if you see them, there can be colorful, brighteness. People take a lot of photos, for having a memory of what they did, of their vacations, achieving their goals etc, I like taking photos of me and my family, because it is amazing how time flies, since I was 3 years old to 15 that I’m know, also I like taking photos of all my achievments, so when the time passes and I see the photo, I will feel that memory on my heart.
My favorite photograph is with my team on a National Championship in Leon, Guanajuato, that trip was amazing, we got first place in basketball, and always I see the photo I get motivated for increasing my level of game, a photograph nowadays is very important.
Although there is people that don’t like taking pictures or being on a photo, they will need to start thinking about it, because a simple photograph can mark all the history of your life.
anchors.noteZh: 内容5/交际效果5/条理性5/语言5。三个问题都充分回答；用个人经历吸引读者（I like taking photos of me and my family, I will feel that memory on my heart），有开头引入和结尾总结（a simple photograph can mark all the history of your life）；各段侧重不同要点，用 because, also, so when the time passes and I see the photo, that trip, Although 等衔接，但第一段常用逗号代替句号；词汇丰富（piece of art, achieving their goals, amazing how time flies, get motivated），尝试较复杂的结构，标点错误较多，但总体不妨碍理解。

q2.explanationZh: 满分文章要回答三个问题：人们为什么爱拍照、自己喜欢拍什么、最喜欢的照片是哪张，并用例子或经历支持；有标题或引入、结尾总结，语气吸引读者，约 100 词。

q3.sampleAnswer:
Chris and Jo were walking through the park when they saw a beautiful little box under a tree. Jo said “what is that unbelievable box it looks so interesting.” And Chris walked to the box and he tried to open it. They were so excited and after he opened it there was a map in the box and it was looking like a treasure map. Jo said “We shouldn’t take this map it looks very secret.” Chris didn’t care Jo and took the map and said “I know this place. We can be rich if we go there come on, move!”
Jo was frightened but she accepted. Then two young friends went to that place and took their dig, shovel and axe. After they took the case they didn’t open it and came back to Chris house and They started to open it. When they opened there was a cucumber in the case and Chris was laughing he said he made a joke.

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：故事以给定的句子开头（Chris 和 Jo 在公园散步时看到树下有一个漂亮的小盒子），围绕盒子里有什么、接下来发生了什么合乎逻辑地展开，有清楚的开头、发展和结尾
交际效果：文体和语气符合任务要求，能清楚表达观点并吸引读者
条理性：结构清晰、衔接连贯，使用多种连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的丰富性与准确性

anchors.response: Chris and Jo were walking through the park when they saw a beautiful little box under a tree. Chris took the box from the floor, he was curious about what was inside of it. Jo was curious too but more than that she wasn’t very comfortable to open it. “Maybe we should leave it where we found,” she said. But Chris didn’t listen to her and open the box. Inside of the box there was a beautiful ring. Then suddenly they heard a man screaming to them. The man who was screaming come close to them and start accusing Chris by saying that he stole the ring from him. Chris was shocked and he didn’t know what he suppossed to do. Jo calm the man down and explain the situation to him, after that the man feel bad for what he did and he apologize to Chris.
anchors.noteZh: 内容5/交际效果5/条理性4/语言4。故事承接开头句有逻辑地展开；用直接引语、人物互动和情感描写（he was curious, she wasn’t very comfortable, Chris was shocked, the man feel bad for what he did）吸引读者，结尾清楚；开头、中间、结尾分明，用 but more than that, Then suddenly, The man who was screaming, after that 等衔接；词汇恰当（curious, screaming, accusing, shocked, explain the situation, apologize），动词时态有一些错误（start accusing, what he suppossed to do, Jo calm the man down），但不妨碍理解。

q3.explanationZh: 满分故事要用给定句开头，围绕“盒子里有什么、发生了什么”展开连贯的情节，有清楚的结尾；用过去时叙述，适当加入对话和人物感受，约 100 词。
